  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The diff to .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json adds "ai:operator-step" and "ai:codex" but no "ai:engine-claude" entry, even though .claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:12 ("Add `ai:engine-claude` (a §23.B routine label write)") and .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:11 ("add the `ai:engine-claude` label to it (a §23.B routine label write)") both apply it. - requirement: The retired-files manifest (`workflow-templates/retired_files.txt`) must list every `.claude/` file the source no longer ships so consumer repos can delete the ones that match a released version. The plan explicitly calls out `Ensure .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md is deleted (it has no twin)` (replace-claude-sessions plan, step 8 list) and adds that path belongs in retired_files.txt (step 5 list).
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/retired_files.txt.
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff deletes .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md (line "deleted file mode 100644" in the PR diff) and 12 other retired paths. workflow-templates/retired_files.txt has 11 entries — claude-issue-dispatch.md, fix-claude-pr.md, check_in_status.py, claude_fix_claim.py, stale_routines.py, permission_prompts.py, dispatch_workflow.py, edit_comment.py, security_pass_skip.py, pr_check_in_reminder.py, permission_prompt_logger.py — but no `.claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md` line, so a consumer carrying the old pickup will not be cleaned up by update_workflows.yml's "Remove retired upstream files" step (the .claude/ sync never deletes). The plan also calls out `permission_prompts.py` was "only used by implement-plan-claude" and `claude-issue-pickup.md` had no twin; both are in scope for the same retired-files sweep.

- File: scripts/activation_verify.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 127, 130-131 (the `git diff --name-only "${MERGE_SHA:-HEAD}^1" "${MERGE_SHA:-HEAD}"` fallback when MERGE_SHA is unset)
  Issue: In `project` mode run_project_activation_verify passes only `FINAL_PR` (a PR number, not a SHA) and leaves MERGE_SHA empty, so the fallback becomes `git diff HEAD^1 HEAD` against the detached FETCH_HEAD worktree. That only shows the most recent commit's changes rather than the full project diff, and `2>/dev/null` on the diff masks a fatal "Not a valid object name" when the very first commit lands on a brand-new default branch. The resulting `files` arg in the context JSON is then empty or wrong.
  Suggested minimal fix: In `project` mode, resolve `FINAL_PR` to its merge commit via `gh api repos/<repo>/pulls/<n>` (the caller already has `REPOSITORY`), then export `MERGE_SHA` from that before invoking activation_verify.sh. Also drop the silent `2>/dev/null` on the git diff so a missing parent is logged (`ACTIVATION_VERIFY mode=project item=<n> outcome=skip reason=invalid_diff`).
  Estimated lines changed: ~6
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: run_project_activation_verify (line 588-589: `git fetch --quiet origin "${verify_default}"` and `git worktree add --quiet --detach "${verify_dir}" FETCH_HEAD`)
  Issue: The function assumes the local remote is named `origin` and that `origin/HEAD` (line 583) is set. In a fresh clone with `actions/checkout@v5` `origin` is created but `origin/HEAD` is not set unless a default branch was explicitly requested. The fallback chain (`FINAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH` / `DEFAULT_BRANCH_TRACKING` / `origin/HEAD` / `main`) handles `origin/HEAD` being empty but if `origin` itself is missing the worktree path fails silently. The `2>/dev/null` on the fetch and worktree add hide the root cause.
  Suggested minimal fix: Source scripts/git_ref_health_check.sh (already staged by the same job) and verify the `origin` remote exists and `origin/HEAD` resolves; on failure, log `ACTIVATION_VERIFY mode=project item=<n> outcome=skip reason=no_origin` instead of failing into the worktree_add branch. Alternatively, dispatch a one-off `gh repo view --json default_branch` against `${REPOSITORY}` to learn the default branch directly from the API, sidestepping the local remote state.
  Estimated lines changed: ~5
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2

  Line or code reference: labels object
  Issue: The PR adds two new labels (`ai:operator-step`, `ai:codex`) but does not declare them in `phase_groups` even though `ai:operator-step` is the policy's per-repo latch for steps only a person can take.
